integrity: All parameter assertions have a self-contained proof. Finite exact checks corroborate but cannot prove all-dimensional results. The known Eulerian volume formula is attributed.
scientific_limitations: Only standard integral hypersimplices and positive integer dilations; no claim for arbitrary lattice or matroid polytopes. Historical novelty not independently established.
title: Lattice-diameter segments of every hypersimplex: an exact Ehrhart decomposition and a degree drop
